ko: 현재 이미지·오디오 생성 모델을 연구하는 독립 연구자입니다. Dual-Solver(ICLR 2026)와 RBF-Solver를 통해 디퓨전 샘플링의 속도와 품질을 연구하고, 모두의연구소에서 생성 모델 연구 랩 logp(x)를 운영하고 있습니다.

이전에는 가우디오랩에서 노래방 데이터 제작을 위한 GTS 음악·가사 동기화 모델을 고도화했고, 비브스튜디오스에서는 버츄얼 휴먼을 위한 TTS·voice conversion 통합 모델 VSpeech를 연구했습니다. 그에 앞서 가우디오랩의 GSEP 음원 분리·FOLLE 사운드 생성 모델과 SM Entertainment의 에브리싱 가창 평가·셀러브리티 개인화 TTS를 개발했습니다. 음성 생성·추출·오디오 신호 처리에 관한 특허 3건에도 공동 발명자로 참여했습니다.

연구 내용을 함께 이해하고 활용하는 교육·공개 해설 활동도 이어 왔습니다. YouTube 채널 @deep_hitch에서는 Flow Matching, ELBO, Diffusion, KL-Divergence를 설명합니다. 기업의 Stable Diffusion 원리와 응용 강의, 서울특별시교육청과 ETRI의 AI 교육, 멀티캠퍼스의 생성 모델·베이지안 통계 강의, 모두의연구소의 오디오 처리 강의를 진행했으며, AIfactory·AIFrenz·MODUCON에서도 디퓨전과 음악 생성에 관해 발표했습니다.

커뮤니티에서는 Stable Diffusion 3, 음성인식과 음성합성, PRML로 이해하는 베이지안, Deep Generative Models 과정을 운영했습니다. 2022년 AI 양재 허브 인공지능 오픈소스 경진대회에는 팀원으로 참여해 1위를 기록했고, Rubato Lab의 음악 생성 모델 개발과 GTA Lab·ML Lab의 연구·스터디에도 참여했습니다. 이전의 Android 앱·오디오 DSP 개발 경험과 동아음악콩쿠르·음악춘추콩쿠르 작곡 수상 이력도 갖고 있습니다.
서울대학교에서 작곡을 전공하고 컴퓨터공학을 복수전공했습니다. 작곡 졸업 작품으로 인터랙티브 음악 WOBBLE을, 컴퓨터공학 졸업 프로젝트로 청음 훈련 Android 앱 Earoid를 제작했습니다.
en: I am an independent researcher working on generative models for images and audio. My work on Dual-Solver, published at ICLR 2026, and RBF-Solver focuses on diffusion sampling speed and quality. I also lead the logp(x) generative models research lab at MODULABS.

Previously, I refined GTS at GAUDIOLAB for music–lyrics synchronization and karaoke data preparation, and worked on VSpeech, an integrated TTS and voice conversion model for virtual humans, at VIVESTUDIOS. Earlier work included GSEP for source separation and FOLLE for sound generation at GAUDIOLAB, and singing assessment for EVERYSING and personalized celebrity TTS at SM Entertainment. I am also a co-inventor on three patents concerning speech generation, voice extraction and audio signal processing.

I share this research through teaching and public explanations. On my YouTube channel, @deep_hitch, I explain Flow Matching, ELBO, Diffusion and KL-Divergence. I have taught corporate courses on Stable Diffusion, AI programs for the Seoul Metropolitan Office of Education and ETRI, generative modeling and Bayesian statistics at Multicampus, and audio processing at MODULABS. My talks at AIfactory, AIFrenz and MODUCON have covered diffusion and music generation.

In the community, I have facilitated courses on Stable Diffusion 3, speech recognition and synthesis, Bayesian understanding with PRML, and deep generative models. I was a member of the first-place team in the 2022 AI Yangjae Hub AI Open Source Competition, developed music generation models at Rubato Lab, and participated in research and study groups at GTA Lab and ML Lab. My earlier experience includes Android applications and audio DSP, alongside composition awards at the Dong-A and Music Chunchu competitions.

I studied Music Composition with a double major in Computer Science at Seoul National University. My graduation projects were WOBBLE, an interactive music work, and Earoid, an Android ear-training application.

이전 연구는 음악·음성 분야에 걸쳐 있습니다. 가우디오랩의 음악·가사 동기화와 음원 분리, 비브스튜디오스의 TTS·화자 변환, SM Entertainment의 가창 평가와 개인화 TTS를 다뤘습니다. 논문으로는 HCLAS-X, KimchiSpeech, GSEP가 있으며, 음성 생성·추출·오디오 신호 처리에 관한 특허에도 공동 발명자로 참여했습니다.

이러한 연구 주제는 공개 해설과 강의에서도 다루고 있습니다. YouTube @deep_hitch에서는 Flow Matching, ELBO, Diffusion, KL-Divergence를 설명하고, 기업의 Stable Diffusion 강의와 교육기관의 AI 교육, 멀티캠퍼스의 생성 모델·베이지안 통계 강의를 진행해 왔습니다. AIfactory에서는 DDPM·DDIM을, AIFrenz와 MODUCON에서는 AI 음악과 음악 생성 모델을 발표했습니다.
공동 학습 경험으로는 모두의연구소 풀잎스쿨의 Stable Diffusion 3, 음성인식과 음성합성, PRML로 이해하는 베이지안, Deep Generative Models 과정 운영이 있습니다. Rubato Lab에서 음악 생성 모델을 개발했고, GTA Lab의 생성 모델·스타일 전이 연구와 ML Lab의 PRML 스터디에도 참여했습니다.
서울대학교에서 작곡을 전공하고 컴퓨터공학을 복수전공했습니다. 인터랙티브 음악 WOBBLE과 청음 훈련 앱 Earoid를 각각의 졸업 프로젝트로 제작하며 음악과 소프트웨어를 함께 다뤘습니다.
en: I am an independent researcher working on diffusion sampling and generative models for images and audio. In Dual-Solver, published at ICLR 2026, I studied a generalized ODE solver through parameterization of prediction types. In RBF-Solver, I explored multistep sampling with radial basis function interpolation. I also lead logp(x) at MODULABS, where we study the core principles of generative models.

My earlier research spans music and speech: lyrics synchronization and source separation at GAUDIOLAB, TTS and voice conversion at VIVESTUDIOS, and singing assessment and personalized TTS at SM Entertainment. Related papers include HCLAS-X, KimchiSpeech and GSEP. I am also a co-inventor on patents concerning speech generation, voice extraction and audio signal processing.

I discuss these research areas through public explanations and teaching. On YouTube, @deep_hitch, I explain Flow Matching, ELBO, Diffusion and KL-Divergence. I have taught corporate Stable Diffusion courses, institutional AI programs, and generative modeling and Bayesian statistics at Multicampus. My talks covered DDPM and DDIM at AIfactory, and AI music and music generation models at AIFrenz and MODUCON.

My collaborative learning experience includes facilitating Stable Diffusion 3, speech recognition and synthesis, Bayesian understanding with PRML, and deep generative models at MODULABS Puliip School. I developed music generation models at Rubato Lab and participated in generative modeling and style transfer research at GTA Lab and the PRML study group at ML Lab.

I studied Music Composition with a double major in Computer Science at Seoul National University. My graduation projects, the interactive music work WOBBLE and the ear-training application Earoid, brought together music and software.

Earlier projects included GSEP for source separation and FOLLE for sound generation at GAUDIOLAB, and singing assessment and personalized TTS at SM Entertainment. I contributed to HCLAS-X, KimchiSpeech and GSEP, and am a co-inventor on patents concerning speech generation, voice extraction and audio processing.

I have taught Stable Diffusion, generative modeling, Bayesian statistics and deep learning for audio processing. On YouTube, @deep_hitch, I explain Flow Matching, ELBO, Diffusion and KL-Divergence. I have also shared related work through a diffusion talk at AIfactory and AI music and music generation talks at AIFrenz and MODUCON.

My community work includes facilitating Stable Diffusion 3, speech recognition and synthesis, PRML and deep generative models. I developed music generation models at Rubato Lab and participated in generative modeling and style transfer research and PRML study groups at GTA Lab and ML Lab. Earlier work included audio DSP and music-related Android applications.

I studied Music Composition with a double major in Computer Science at Seoul National University. My graduation projects were WOBBLE, an interactive music work, and Earoid, an ear-training application.

서울대학교에서 작곡을 전공하고 컴퓨터공학을 복수전공했습니다. 인터랙티브 음악 WOBBLE과 청음 훈련 앱 Earoid를 각각의 졸업 프로젝트로 제작했습니다.
en: I am an independent researcher working on image and audio generation, and explain Flow Matching, ELBO, Diffusion and KL-Divergence on YouTube, @deep_hitch. My recent research includes Dual-Solver, published at ICLR 2026, and RBF-Solver. I also lead the logp(x) generative models lab at MODULABS.

Previously, I worked on music–lyrics synchronization at GAUDIOLAB and integrated TTS and voice conversion at VIVESTUDIOS. Earlier projects included source separation and sound generation at GAUDIOLAB, and singing assessment and personalized TTS at SM Entertainment. My background also includes Android applications and audio DSP.

My explanations of these technologies extend to courses and talks. I have taught corporate Stable Diffusion courses, AI programs for the Seoul Metropolitan Office of Education and ETRI, generative modeling and Bayesian statistics at Multicampus, and audio processing at MODULABS. My talks at AIfactory, AIFrenz and MODUCON have covered diffusion, AI music and music generation models.

In the community, I have facilitated Stable Diffusion 3, speech recognition and synthesis, PRML and deep generative models, developed music generation models at Rubato Lab, and participated in research and study groups at GTA Lab and ML Lab. Research, implementation, teaching, collaborative learning and public explanations are all parts of my work.

I studied Music Composition with a double major in Computer Science at Seoul National University. My graduation projects were WOBBLE, an interactive music work, and Earoid, an ear-training application.

original.en: I conduct research on generative models for images and audio. I have developed deep learning models related to music games and applications, as well as speech and sound, across multiple startups. I currently work as an independent researcher based on this experience. I also lead a lab at MODULABS that studies core principles of generative models, and I continue to teach courses to help disseminate these techniques.
